subject: [PATCH v6 1/2] fuse: bound io-uring payload copies to the registered buffer size

reviews.author: Xiang Mei
reviews.summary: Reviewer Xiang Mei suggested removing the BUG_ON in fuse_copy_fill() and returning an error instead, which would simplify the code and make backporting to stable easier.
reviews.raw_body:
Thanks for your suggestions; this patch is better, and I have sent and
tested v7:

https://lore.kernel.org/fuse-devel/20260910022442.3594649-1-xmei5@asu.edu/T/#t

Xiang

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the FUSE (Filesystem in Userspace) driver that breaks zero-copy reads when the payload length is zero. The fix involves removing a BUG_ON statement and returning an error instead, making it easier to backport to stable kernels. Additionally, the patch separates the errno handling for FUSE_SETXATTR into its own patch.
